transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, well... I guess people are starting to notice that I can't really just sit and listen. I keep getting up when I'm supposed to stay put. Like... during client interviews, or even book club. So, that's why I'm here.
When did you first start having trouble sitting still like this?
Um... I'd say it's been noticeably worse for about eight months. That's... well, that's when I had to move out of my old apartment in Chicago.

Did you have similar trouble sitting still or staying focused when you were growing up, such as in elementary school?

Um... yeah, I guess so. My grade-school report cards always said I was bright, but... that I couldn't stay in my seat. Or wait my turn. My mother actually still jokes about it sometimes. She says I treated every classroom like a... like a crime scene I had to pace through. So, yes.
Do you also find it difficult to sustain your attention on tasks, or do you frequently make careless mistakes at work?
Um... no, not really. I mean, my attention is fine. I do my job well. I don't... I don't really make careless mistakes. That's not an issue for me.
